consensus_boundary.locator: §9, transition after Table 16 on printed p.25 and paragraph introducing equation (63), printed p.26

consensus_boundary.unspecified: No equation (64), dark-uncertainty or CODATA numerical input authorized.

copper.locator: §9, Figure 25 caption and adjacent paragraphs, printed pp.24-25; Figure 14, printed p.17
copper.supplies: Joint model G(theta)=Gi+A*sin(theta-theta0), common amplitude/phase and two method intercepts; posterior means and standard deviations form copper summaries.
copper.unspecified: Likelihood, copper-stage prior distributions and a global directional equivariance contract are not specified in these reviewed passages. Later consensus priors are a separate stage.

corrections.locator: §3.2-3.3, equation (20) and following paragraph, printed pp.6-8
corrections.supplies: Recovered electrostatic torque difference converts using equation (5); residual elastic torque kappa delta_phi is added for finite servo gain.
corrections.unspecified: No new correction is inferred; operational injection is after declared existing extraction/corrections.

geometry.locator: Table 15 caption/last two columns, printed p.25; Table 10 and §6.8, printed p.17
geometry.supplies: Table 15 explicitly prescribes delta_N=G*16*Gamma_max*ms*mt/Rs; Table 10 distinguishes full half-difference from peak and has a dimensionally inconsistent Gamma column heading relative to §3.1.
geometry.unspecified: Table 15 named Gamma_max is used solely in its explicitly printed conversion. It is not independently identified as a true exact peak or full half-difference; Table 10 numbers are not substituted.

masses.locator: Table 2 caption and footnotes a/b, printed p.10
masses.supplies: Per-body averages; apparent source masses are air-buoyancy corrected.
masses.unspecified: Unrounded masses and their joint physical uncertainty are not recovered.

orders.locator: Table 15 rows/columns and Table 16 labels, printed p.25
orders.supplies: Table 15 row order sapphire, copper 0, copper 120, copper 240; torque columns free then servo. Table 16 order copper servo, copper free, sapphire servo, sapphire free.

rotation.supplies: Common-geometry homogeneous torque plus shared sinusoid; three clockings cancel that sinusoid in the stated ideal identity.
rotation.unspecified: Identity does not specify the final posterior estimator for differing campaign gains and errors.

sapphire.locator: §9, Table 15 caption and paragraphs surrounding Figure 25/Table 16, printed p.25
sapphire.supplies: One sapphire campaign per method; preliminary ratios followed by corresponding quantities combined with copper to form four determinations.
sapphire.unspecified: No explicit sapphire posterior/summary functional or directional equivariance statement in these passages; identity is only an additional assumption.

torque.supplies: General difference gain 8 ms mt (Gamma_plus-Gamma_minus)/Rs; symmetric approximation uses 16 ms mt Gamma_max/Rs. Positive source azimuth is counterclockwise viewed from above.
torque.unspecified: Campaign-specific separate extrema are not tabulated in the reviewed passages.
